en: The Information & Communications Technology Services Unit (ICT-SU) of Bukidnon State University. It handles the technical aspect of university processes involving information systems, network, technical services, and web development. ICT-SU is also responsible for maintaining all computers in the computer laboratories, and ensures that any issues or damages in the labs are addressed promptly. You may also approach them for technical assistance regarding computer facilities.

Sila usab ang ga-mentinar sa mga computer sulod sa computer laboratory, ug kung naay mga posibleng damage sa mga computers, sila usab ang ga-ayo niini. Pwede ka mo-doul sa ila alang sa tabang sa technical nga aspeto sa computer facilities.

en: The Bachelor of Science in Information Technology program includes the study of the utilization of both hardware and software technologies involving planning, installing, customizing, operating, managing and administering, and maintaining information technology infrastructure that provides computing solutions to address the needs of an organization.
The program prepares graduates to address various user needs involving the selection, development, application, integration and management of computing technologies within an organization.

en: Bachelor of Science in Food Technology is a four-year degree program design to develop professionals in food technology. The program focuses on a mix of pure and applied science, engineering, business, and entrepreneurial skills. It aims to produce professionals who have the capacity to apply the science and technology and related fields of study in post-harvest handling, preparation, processing, packaging, storage, distribution, and marketing of food to ensure food and nutrition security, quality, environmental sustainability and the well-being of individuals, families and communities. The program also aims to promote continued excellence in food science education.
ceb: Ang Bachelor of Science in Food Technology usa ka upat ka tuig nga degree program nga gidisenyo aron mag-develop og mga propesyonal sa food technology. Ang programa nagpunting sa kombinasyon sa pure ug applied science, engineering, business, ug entrepreneurial skills. Tumong niini ang pag-produce og mga propesyonal nga adunay kapasidad sa paggamit sa siyensya ug teknolohiya ug uban pang may kalabotan nga larangan sa post-harvest handling, preparation, processing, packaging, storage, distribution, ug marketing sa pagkaon aron masiguro ang food ug nutrition security, kalidad, environmental sustainability, ug kaayohan sa mga indibidwal, pamilya, ug komunidad. Ang programa usab nagtumong sa pagpalambo sa padayon nga kahusayan sa food science education.

en: The Bachelor of Science in Entertainment and Multimedia Computing is the study and use of concepts, principles, and techniques of computing in the design and development of multimedia products and solutions. It includes various applications such as in science, entertainment, education, simulations and advertising.

The program enables the students to be knowledgeable of the whole pipeline of Digital Animation projects. The students will acquire the independence and creative competencies to articulate project design and requirements of new projects, not necessarily based on standard templates.

The Digital Animation Technology major is the study and application of fundamental and advanced theories and techniques in 2D and 3D animation, use and development for advancement of animation technologies and production of commercially acceptable content and viable solutions for different platforms such as broadcast, web and mobile cast.
ceb: Ang Bachelor of Science in Entertainment and Multimedia Computing mao ang pagtuon ug paggamit sa mga konsepto, prinsipyo, ug teknik sa computing sa pagdesinyo ug pag-develop sa multimedia products ug solutions. Naglakip kini og lain-laing aplikasyon sama sa science, entertainment, education, simulations, ug advertising.

Ang programa naghatag sa estudyante og kahibalo sa tibuok proseso sa Digital Animation projects. Ang mga estudyante makabaton og independence ug creative competencies aron ma-articulate ang project design ug requirements sa bag-ong proyekto, dili lang base sa standard templates.

Ang Digital Animation Technology major mao ang pagtuon ug aplikasyon sa fundamental ug advanced nga teorya ug teknik sa 2D ug 3D animation, paggamit ug pag-develop alang sa pag-uswag sa animation technologies ug paghimo sa commercially acceptable content ug viable solutions para sa lain-laing platforms sama sa broadcast, web, ug mobile cast.

follow_up: PROGRAM OBJECTIVES

a. Game development professionals with specialized knowledge, competencies and values in designing, developing, and producing digital games and/or tools and in managing game development projects for various applications.

b. Digital animation professionals who are equipped with both creative and technical knowledge, skills, and values in conceptualizing, designing and producing animation products and solutions, and in managing such projects over different technology platforms.
2. To provide students with:
a. Comprehensive and relevant training for personal growth and lifelong learning.
b. Quality education necessary to become ethical professionals imbued with multi-cultural sensitivity and innovative leadership.
c. Cognitive abilities and technical skills to become globally competitive professionals.
3. To inculcate students’ social, ethical and professional responsibility through active participation in community involvement and extension activities.
4. To enhance students’ technical and academic capabilities through research and development.

en: How can I take the BukSU College Admission Test?
Follow these steps to apply for the BukSU College Admission Test:
Step 1: Access http://admissions.buksu.edu.ph. Register using your active Gmail account. Create your password and re-type it for verification.
Step 2: After creating an account, an email containing a confirmation link will be sent to your Gmail. Check your inbox and click the link to activate your account.
Step 3: Fill out all the necessary information and upload the documentary requirements.
Step 4: Select your preferred schedule (venue, date, and time) based on the availability of slots.
Step 5: You will get notifications when your application is accepted. Once accepted, download and print your Test Permit.
ceb: Unsaon nako pagkuha sa BukSU College Admission Test?
Sunod kining mga lakang aron mag-apply sa BukSU College Admission Test:
Step 1: Bisitaha ang http://admissions.buksu.edu.ph. Mag-register gamit ang imong active nga Gmail account. Himoa ang imong password ug i-type pag-usab para sa verification.
Step 2: Human makahimo og account, usa ka email nga adunay confirmation link ipadala sa imong Gmail. Tan-awa ang imong inbox ug i-klik ang link aron ma-activate ang imong account.
Step 3: Pun-a ang tanan nga kinahanglan nga impormasyon ug i-upload ang mga documentary requirements.
Step 4: Pilia ang imong preferred schedule (venue, petsa, ug oras) base sa available nga slots.
Step 5: Makadawat ka og notifications kung gi-accept ang imong aplikasyon. Kung ma-accept, i-download ug i-print ang imong Test Permit.

follow_up: Make sure all your information and documents are correct to avoid delays in your application.
Keep track of your preferred schedule and check your email regularly for notifications.

en: I have already filled out the online application. What is the next step?

Make sure that you have completed the application process and prepare all the necessary requirements before the day of testing.

follow_up: Double-check that all documents are uploaded correctly to avoid issues on the test day.
Keep an eye on your email for notifications regarding your schedule and Test Permit.

en: No Slots Available?

follow_up: Keep refreshing the schedule page regularly to catch any new available slots.

en: Are there fees for the College Admission Test?
College Admission Tests are offered for FREE at Bukidnon State University.
However, applicants who have already completed a bachelors degree (second course takers) need to pay 300 Php for the Admission Test.
They are not qualified to avail of the benefits of the Free Higher Education.
ceb: Naay bayad ang College Admission Test?
Ang College Admission Tests libre ra sa Bukidnon State University.
Apan, ang mga aplikante nga nakakompleto na og bachelor's degree (second course takers) kinahanglan magbayad og 300 Php para sa Admission Test.
Dili sila kwalipikado sa mga benepisyo sa Free Higher Education.

follow_up: Make sure to check your eligibility before applying for the free test.
Second course takers should prepare the payment of 300 Php on or before the test schedule.

en: Wondering what to do if no slots are available?
Keep checking the admissions portal regularly and try submitting your application again.
Additional slots may open up if some applications are denied due to incomplete or missing requirements.
Since these openings can appear at any time, frequent monitoring is recommended.
ceb: Wondering unsa ang buhaton kung walay slots nga available?
padayon og check ang admissions portal kanunay and sulayi og submit imong application pag-usab.
dugang slots posibleng mo open if some application kay nanga deny tungod sa kulang or walay requirements.
kay these openings pwede mo gawas bisan kanus-a, kanunay nga pag check girekomenda.

follow_up: At the moment, this is the information I can provide to help your problem. I appreciate your understanding.

en: There are currently three main locations for the computer laboratories at Bukidnon State University:
• ComLab 8 to 9 are located beside the University Press (UP) Building.
• ComLab 1 to 6 are situated on the 3rd floor of the Finance Building.
• ComLab 11 to 12 can be found in the College of Public Administration and Governance (CPAG) Building.
Sure! Please tell me which college faculty room you are looking for (COT, COB, or CON).
ceb: Sige! Palihug isulti kung unsang college faculty room imong gipangita (COT, COB, or CON).

follow_up: You can ask about: COT, COB, or CON faculty rooms.

en: Located on the 2nd floor of the COT Building.
ceb: Nahimutang sa 2nd floor sa COT Building.

en: Located on the 3rd floor of the Business Building.
ceb: Nahimutang sa 3rd floor sa Business Building.

en: Located near the Nursing Skills Laboratory.
ceb: Nahimutang duol sa Nursing Skills Laboratory.

en: Transferees from public schools may enroll, subject to the evaluation of their academic records.
However, students transferring from private schools should expect possible delays in the process.
Please note that for private school transferees, previously taken subjects may not be credited.
As a result, you may be required to retake courses as a first-year student.
ceb: Ang mga transferees gikan sa public schools mahimong maka-enroll basta ma-evaluate ang ilang academic records.
Apan ang mga estudyante nga mobalhin gikan sa private schools kinahanglan mag-expect og posibleng delay sa proseso.
Palihog timan-i nga para sa mga transferees gikan sa private schools, posibleng dili ma-credit ang ilang mga previous subjects.
Tungod niini, mahimong kinahanglan nimo kuhaon balik ang mga subject sama sa usa ka first-year student.

en: Students are required to pay for laboratory, ID, and miscellaneous fees.
Tuition is free at Bukidnon State University.
However, some courses may have additional charges for laboratory equipment and required textbooks.
ceb: Kinahanglan magbayad ang mga estudyante para sa laboratory, ID, ug miscellaneous fees.
Libre ang tuition sa Bukidnon State University.
Apan naa gihapon ubang mga kurso nga naay dugang bayranan para sa laboratory equipment ug mga gikinahanglan nga libro.

en: Yes, freshmen are allowed to join recognized BukSU student organizations.
ceb: Oo, pwede moapil ang mga freshmen sa mga giila nga BukSU student organizations.

en: The National Service Training Program (NSTP) is a required civic service program for BukSU students.
ceb: Ang National Service Training Program (NSTP) kay usa ka required civic service program sa BukSU.

en: Yes, Physical Education is part of BukSU’s general curriculum.
ceb: Oo, apil ang Physical Education (PE) sa general curriculum sa BukSU.

en: According to BukSU academic policies, you may retake a subject if it is your first time failing it.
However, please note that failing a subject multiple times, up to three total attempts, may lead to serious consequences.
In some cases, this may include being advised to transfer to another school.
For more specific details and proper guidance, it is recommended to consult your college faculty.
ceb: Sumala sa academic policies sa BukSU, pwede ka mokuha balik og subject kung first time pa nimo nga nabagsak.
Apan palihog timan-i nga kung mabagsak nimo ang usa ka subject ug makadaghang beses, hangtod tulo ka attempts, mahimo kini magdala og seryosong mga resulta.
Lakip niini ang posibilidad nga marekomenda ka nga mobalhin og laing eskwelahan.
Mas maayo nga mokonsulta ka sa imong college faculty para sa mas klaro nga detalye ug hustong giya.

en: Yes, course shifting is allowed at BukSU, especially after finishing your first year course.
However, please note that usually only minor subjects are credited.
This means you will not need to retake those specific classes in your new program.
It is rare for major subjects to be credited, so it is recommended to check with the Registrar’s Office for more details.

Please also keep in mind that for certain specific courses, you are not permitted to shift during the second semester. In these cases, you must complete your entire first year in your current program before you are eligible to transfer to a different course.
ceb: Oo, pwede ra mag-shift og course sa BukSU, labi na kung first year pa.
Apan palihog timan-i nga kasagaran mga minor subjects ra ang ma-credit.
Pasabot niini nga dili na nimo kinahanglan kuhaon balik ang mga maong subject sa imong bag-ong kurso.
Talagsa ra kaayo nga ma-credit ang major subjects, mao nga mas maayo mangutana ka sa Registrar’s Office para sa mas klaro nga detalye.

Palihog hinumdumi usab nga para sa pipila ka espesipikong kurso, dili tugotan ang pag-shift sa ikaduhang semester. Sa ing-ani nga mga kaso, kinahanglan nimo tapuson ang tibuok first year sa imong current nga programa usa ka pa mahimong eligible nga mobalhin sa lain nga kurso.

en: Yes, Bukidnon State University has campus security personnel on duty to help ensure student safety.
ceb: Oo, adunay campus security personnel ang Bukidnon State University nga nagbantay aron masiguro ang kaluwasan sa mga estudyante.

en: Getting lost on campus is rare, but if it happens, you may ask staff members, security guards, or fellow students for directions.
I can also provide a campus map to help you navigate more easily.
You may ask me about a specific place, and I will check if I can help you locate it.
ceb: Talagsa ra ni mahitabo, apan kung mahitabo man, pwede ka mangutana sa staff, mga guard, o ubang estudyante para sa direksyon.
Pwede usab ko mohatag og mapa aron mas sayon ang pag-navigate sa campus.
Pwede pud ka mangutana nako sa usa ka specific nga lugar, ug tan-awon nako kung makatabang ba ko sa pagpangita niini.

en: You can access the BukSU SIAS portal using the link provided.
Please use the account credentials assigned to you, which can be found on the BukSU Admission website.
If you need help locating your account details, just ask: 'How do I find my BukSU SIAS account on the admission website?'
ceb: Pwede nimo ma-access ang BukSU SIAS portal gamit ang gihatag nga link.
Gamiton ang account credentials nga gi-assign sa imoha, nga makita sa BukSU Admission website.
Kung kinahanglan nimo og tabang sa pagpangita sa imong account details, pwede ka mangutana: 'How do I find my BukSU SIAS account on the admission website?'

en: Yes, some programs offer peer mentoring for lower-year students.
ceb: Oo, naay peer mentoring programs para sa lower-year students.

en: Yes, parents and guests are allowed to attend graduation ceremonies.
ceb: Oo, pwede mo-attend ang parents ug mga bisita sa graduation ceremonies.

en: Yes, attendance during the graduation rehearsal is usually mandatory.
ceb: Oo, kasagaran required ang attendance sa graduation rehearsal.

en: A tracer study tracks graduates’ employment status and is usually required.
ceb: Ang tracer study nag-track sa employment status sa mga graduate, ug kasagaran required gyud ni.

en: Yes, some documents can be requested before graduation.
ceb: Oo, pwede mag-request ug documents bisan wala pa graduate.

en: Shifting courses in the third year is possible, but it may delay graduation.
ceb: Pwede mag-shift pero basin ma-delay ang graduation.

en: Students may be required to revise and re-defend their thesis within a specified timeframe.
If the second defense is unsuccessful, the student may need to retake the thesis or capstone subject.
ceb: Ang mga estudyante mahimo nga kinahanglan mag-revise ug mag-redefend sa ilang thesis sulod sa gihatag nga oras.
Kung mapakyas sa ikaduhang defense, mahimo nga kinahanglan nila kuhaon pag-usab ang thesis o capstone subject.

en: A thesis defense is a formal presentation where students defend their research.
ceb: Ang thesis defense kay usa ka formal presentation sa research.

en: The thesis defense usually consists of a three-member panel and one secretary, though this may vary depending on the specific course.
ceb: Kasagaran ang defense adunay tulo ka panel members ug usa ka secretary, apan mahimong lahi-lahi depende sa kurso.

en: Yes, thesis topics are usually proposed by students and approved by advisers.
ceb: Oo, ang topic gi-propose sa students ug i-approve sa adviser.

follow_up: What topics are not allowed?

en: Not all courses require an internship; it depends on the curriculum.
ceb: Dili tanan kurso naay internship, depende sa curriculum.

en: Yes, transferring to another campus is possible, subject to campus policies and approval.
ceb: Oo, depende sa policy ug approval sa campus.

en: The dean’s list recognizes students with excellent academic performance.
ceb: Ang dean’s list para sa students nga taas ug grado.

en: Academic probation is given to students with low academic performance.
ceb: Ang academic probation ihatag sa students nga ubos ug performance.

en: Regular attendance is required and strictly recorded.
If you need to be absent, you must provide a valid reason and supporting documentation for approval.
Please remember that accumulating 7 absences will result in an FDA (Failure Due to Absences).
ceb: Oo, kinahanglan gyud ang regular nga pag-attend ug strictly kining ginarecord.
Kung kinahanglan ka mag-absent, kinahanglan maghatag ka ug valid nga rason ug supporting documents para ma-approve.
Timan-i nga kung maka-accumulate ka ug 7 ka absences, moresulta kini sa FDA (Failure Due to Absences).

en: You may add or drop subjects during the official add/drop period at the Registrar's Office.
To help you find your way, I have provided a map you can use to navigate to the office.
ceb: Pwede ka makadugang o makatangtang ug subject sulod sa official add/drop period sa Registrar’s Office.
Aron mas sayon nimo makita ang lugar, naghatag ko ug mapa nga pwede nimo gamiton padulong sa opisina.

en: You can obtain your Certificate of Enrollment (COR) through the BukSU Admission Portal.
Once your enrollment is complete, your COR is automatically generated.
You may then download and print it to proceed with the validation process.
ceb: Makakuha nimo ang imong Certificate of Enrollment (COR) pinaagi sa BukSU Admission Portal.
Kung mahuman na ang imong enrollment, automatic nga ma-generate ang imong COR.
Pwede na nimo kini i-download ug i-print para magpadayon sa validation process.

en: If a group member becomes inactive, it is best to inform your instructor about the situation as early as possible.
ceb: Kung naay inactive nga group member, mas maayo nga i-inform dayon ang instructor sa sitwasyon.

en: If you are feeling stressed or overwhelmed, consider seeking help from your advisers, counselors, or trusted university staff.
ceb: Kung gibati nimo nga stressed o overwhelmed ka, mangayo ug tabang sa adviser, counselor, o kasaligan nga staff sa unibersidad.

en: Assignments may be submitted via email or through platforms like Google Classroom, depending on your instructor's preference. To submit via Google Classroom:
1. Open the specific subject with the pending assignment.
2. If you can’t find it, tap the Menu (three lines) on the top left and select 'To-do.'
3. Select the assignment, attach your file, and click 'Turn in.
4. Once the status changes to 'Turned in,' your submission is complete.
ceb: Ang mga assignment pwede ipasa pinaagi sa email o sa mga platform sama sa Google Classroom, depende sa gusto sa inyong instructor. Para mopasa gamit ang Google Classroom:
1. Ablihi ang specific nga subject nga naay pending nga assignment.
2. Kung dili nimo makita, i-tap ang Menu (tulo ka linya) sa ibabaw nga wala ug pilia ang 'To-do'.
3. Pilia ang assignment, i-attach ang imong file, ug i-click ang 'Turn in'.
4. Kung mausab na ang status ngadto sa 'Turned in', kumpleto na ang imong submission.

en: The use of mobile phones during class depends on the classroom rules set by the instructor.
ceb: Ang paggamit sa cellphone sulod sa klase depende sa classroom rules nga gi-set sa instructor.

en: Overload refers to taking more subjects than the regular academic load.
ceb: Ang overload kay pagkuha ug mas daghang subjects kaysa sa normal nga academic load.

en: For class-related concerns, you should talk to your instructor first.
ceb: Para sa mga concern sa klase, makigstorya una sa imong instructor.

en: Yes, freshmen are allowed to participate in intramurals.
ceb: Oo, pwede moapil ang freshmen sa intramurals.

en: Intramurals are sports competitions held within the university.
ceb: Ang intramurals kay sports competition sulod sa unibersidad.

en: At the end of the semester, final examinations are conducted, grades are submitted, and clearance processing takes place.
ceb: Sa katapusan sa semester, naay final exams, pag-submit sa grades, ug clearance processing.

en: A minor subject supports your major field of study and helps build general knowledge.
ceb: Ang minor subject kay support sa imong major ug naghatag ug dugang kahibalo.

en: Grades can be viewed once they are officially released.
However, your previous grades remain accessible anytime through the SIAS portal.
ceb: Makita ang grades kung officially released na.
Apan ang imong previous grades pwede gihapon ma-access anytime pinaagi sa SIAS portal.

en: Academic overload for seniors allows graduating students to take additional subjects in order to complete their program on time.
ceb: Ang overload para sa seniors kay pagkuha ug extra subjects aron makagraduate dayon.

en: Some colleges offer board examination review programs or support sessions for students.
ceb: Ang ubang mga college naghatag ug review programs o support sessions para sa board exam.

en: Eating inside classrooms depends on the rules set by the instructor.
ceb: Ang pagkaon sulod sa classroom depende sa rules sa instructor.

en: A licensure examination is a national exam required to legally practice certain professions.
ceb: Ang licensure examination kay national exam nga gikinahanglan para makapraktis sa pipila ka profession.

en: A mock board exam is a practice examination designed to prepare students for the actual licensure examination.
ceb: Ang mock board exam kay practice exam nga gituyo aron andamon ang mga estudyante para sa tinuod nga board exam.

en: On-the-job training (OJT) provides students with real-world work experience related to their course.
ceb: Ang on-the-job training (OJT) naghatag ug real-world nga work experience nga konektado sa imong kurso.

en: This issue commonly occurs among first- and second-year applicants.
Please ensure that your photo meets the required specifications: it must have a pure white background, show you wearing a plain white t-shirt, and contain no accessories.
The photo must also follow the 2x2 format and have a small file size to ensure successful uploading.
After uploading your photo, please allow time for the Admission Officers to review and approve it.
If the issue persists, I recommend visiting the Registrar’s Office for further assistance.
ceb: Kining problema kasagaran mahitabo sa mga first ug second-year nga applicants.
Siguroa nga ang imong litrato nagsunod sa mga required specifications: kinahanglan puti gyud ang background, nagsul-ob ka ug plain nga puti nga t-shirt, ug walay accessories.
Ang litrato kinahanglan usab 2x2 ang size ug gamay ra ang file size aron masiguro nga ma-upload kini og tarong.
Human sa pag-upload, palihog hulata ang approval gikan sa Admission Officers.
Kung magpadayon gihapon ang problema, girekomenda nga moadto ka sa Registrar’s Office aron mangayo ug dugang nga tabang.

en: One of the most common reasons for application denial is an incorrect or non-compliant profile picture.
Please ensure your photo has a pure white background, shows you wearing a plain white t-shirt, contains no accessories, and follows the 2x2 format with a clear image and minimal file size.
Also verify that your account details, such as your full name, contact number, and email address, are accurate and match your admission account.
Additionally, review your submitted requirements, including your Report Card, Transcript of Records, and Principal’s Certification.
Please ensure that all certifications are properly signed by your school principal.
Once all corrections are completed, kindly wait for the Admission Officers to review your application.
If your application continues to be denied, I recommend visiting the Admission Office for further assistance. A campus map is available to help you locate the office.
ceb: Usa sa kasagarang hinungdan sa application denial mao ang profile picture nga wala nagsunod sa required specifications.
Siguroa nga ang imong litrato adunay puti gyud nga background, nagsul-ob ka ug plain nga puti nga t-shirt, walay accessories, ug nagsunod sa 2x2 format nga klaro ang image ug gamay ra ang file size.
Siguroa usab nga sakto ug updated ang imong account details sama sa imong ngalan, contact number, ug email address nga parehas sa imong admission account.
I-review usab ang imong mga requirements sama sa Report Card, Transcript of Records, ug Principal’s Certification.
Siguroa nga ang tanang certifications adunay pirma sa inyong principal.
Human nimo ma-update ang tanan, hulata ang review ug approval gikan sa Admission Officers.
Kung ma-deny gihapon ang imong application, girekomenda nga moadto ka sa Admission Office alang sa dugang nga tabang. Adunay mapa nga makatabang nimo sa pagpangita sa opisina.

en: If your test permit cannot be opened or appears corrupted, this issue may require assistance from the Admission Office.
This may be caused by a system or database-related error that cannot be resolved through basic troubleshooting.
I recommend visiting the Admission Office and informing the staff about the issue so they can assist you directly.
A campus map is available to help you locate the office.
ceb: Kung dili ma-open ang imong test permit o corrupted kini, posible nga kinahanglan kini ug assistance gikan sa Admission Office.
Mahimong tungod kini sa system o database error nga dili masulbad pinaagi sa basic troubleshooting.
Girekomenda nga moadto ka sa Admission Office ug ipahibalo ang staff bahin sa problema aron matabangan ka nila direkta.
Adunay mapa nga makatabang nimo sa pagpangita sa opisina.

en: Application approval may take time due to the high volume of applications being reviewed by the Admission staff.
In most cases, applications are approved about one week before the scheduled examination date.
However, processing times may vary and approval may occur closer to the exam date in some situations.
Please continue monitoring your admission account and allow additional time for the review process.
ceb: Ang approval sa application mahimong modugay tungod sa kadaghan sa applications nga gi-review sa Admission staff.
Sa kasagaran, ang applications ma-aprubahan mga usa ka semana sa wala pa ang exam date.
Apan, ang processing time mahimong magkalain-lain ug usahay ma-aprubahan mas duol sa exam date.
Palihog padayon sa pag-monitor sa imong admission account ug magpailub samtang naghulat sa approval.

en: Class schedules during intramurals week may vary depending on your instructor.
In most cases, there are no formal classes held during this period.
However, participation in intramurals activities is important, as attendance may be monitored by your department and instructors.
I recommend checking with your instructor for specific instructions regarding your class.
ceb: Ang schedule sa klase panahon sa intramurals week nagdepende sa inyong instructor.
Sa kasagaran, walay pormal nga klase niining panahona.
Apan importante ang pag-apil sa intramurals activities kay ang attendance mahimong ginabantayan sa inyong departamento ug instructors.
Mas maayo nga mangutana sa inyong instructor alang sa eksaktong instruksyon bahin sa inyong klase.

en: TES allowance release may take time due to multiple verification and approval processes.
This includes fund release, eligibility validation, and billing verification.
The process involves coordination between DBM, CHED, and the university.
Any missing documents or strict auditing procedures may further delay the release.
I recommend regularly checking with your scholarship coordinator for updates.
ceb: Ang pag-release sa TES allowance mahimong modugay tungod sa daghang proseso sa verification ug approval.
Lakip niini ang pag-release sa pondo, pag-validate sa eligibility, ug pag-verify sa billing documents.
Ang proseso naglakip sa koordinasyon tali sa DBM, CHED, ug sa unibersidad.
Ang kulang nga dokumento o hugot nga auditing mahimong makapahinay sa pag-release sa allowance.
Mas maayo nga mangutana sa inyong scholarship coordinator para sa updates.

en: The BukSU Entrance Examination cannot be rescheduled once your exam date has been assigned.
If you are unable to attend your scheduled exam, you may need to wait for the next admission cycle.
I recommend ensuring your availability on your assigned exam date to avoid delays in your admission.
ceb: Dili ma-reschedule ang BukSU Entrance Examination kung naa na kay assigned exam date.
Kung dili ka makatunga sa imong scheduled exam, mahimo nga kinahanglan ka maghulat sa sunod nga admission cycle.
Mas maayo nga siguroon ang imong availability sa imong exam date aron malikayan ang delay sa imong admission.

en: Students may apply for TES even if they are applicants of other scholarship programs such as REAP or TABUK.
However, TES qualification policies generally do not allow students to receive multiple government-funded educational assistance benefits simultaneously.
Final eligibility is subject to scholarship guidelines and official verification.
I recommend consulting the Scholarship Office for accurate confirmation regarding your eligibility.
ceb: Ang mga estudyante pwede mag-apply sa TES bisan applicant sila sa ubang scholarship programs sama sa REAP o TABUK.
Apan, base sa scholarship policies, dili kasagaran tugotan nga makadawat og daghang government-funded educational assistance sa parehas nga panahon.
Ang final eligibility magdepende sa scholarship guidelines ug official verification.
Mas maayo nga mangutana sa Scholarship Office aron makakuha og eksaktong impormasyon.

en: The official school uniform is required for undergraduate students during regular class days.
Civilian attire is typically allowed on Wednesdays, Saturdays, and Sundays, or when authorized by official announcements.
Formal attire may also be allowed during enrollment periods or official academic activities.
New students are usually given a grace period to prepare their uniforms.
ceb: Ang official school uniform required para sa undergraduate students panahon sa regular class days.
Ang civilian attire kasagaran tugotan matag Miyerkules, Sabado, ug Domingo, o kung adunay official announcement.
Ang formal attire pwede usab panahon sa enrollment o official academic activities.
Ang mga bag-ong estudyante kasagaran hatagan og grace period aron makapangandam sa ilang uniform.

en: BukSU provides on-campus dormitory facilities for students.
Separate dormitories are available for male and female students.
Dormitory policies are strictly implemented to ensure safety and proper accommodation.
I recommend contacting the dormitory office for availability and application requirements.
ceb: Naghatag ang BukSU og on-campus dormitory facilities para sa mga estudyante.
Adunay separate dormitories alang sa lalaki ug babae.
Ang dormitory policies hugot nga ginapatuman aron masiguro ang safety ug proper accommodation.
Mas maayo nga mangutana sa dormitory office alang sa availability ug requirements.

en: Living in BukSU dormitories provides several benefits, including affordable housing, campus security, and convenient access to university facilities.
Dormitories often include basic utilities such as electricity and internet access.
However, residents must follow dormitory rules, including curfew policies and participation in required activities.
Certain restrictions may also apply depending on dormitory regulations.
Dormitory living is recommended for students who prefer convenience and campus accessibility.
ceb: Ang pagpuyo sa BukSU dormitories adunay daghang benepisyo sama sa affordable housing, campus security, ug dali nga access sa university facilities.
Kasagaran apil na ang basic utilities sama sa kuryente ug internet access.
Apan, kinahanglan sundon sa mga residente ang dormitory rules, lakip ang curfew ug required activities.
Adunay usab restrictions depende sa dormitory regulations.
Ang dormitory living maayo para sa mga estudyante nga gusto ug convenience ug duol sa campus.

en: Unfortunately, I do not have information on how to cancel your TABUK assistance, as that program is not managed by BukSU.
Regarding your concerns about eligibility: being in one program does not automatically disqualify you from others.
However, to avoid disqualification from the TES program or other programs, you must ensure you are not actively receiving funds from two different government subsidies at the same time.
ceb: Kasubo, wala ko’y impormasyon kung unsaon pag-cancel sa imong TABUK assistance, kay ang maong programa dili gi-manage sa BukSU.
Bahin sa imong kabalaka bahin sa eligibility: ang pagka-apil sa usa ka programa dili pasabot nga dili na ka pwede moapil sa lain.
Apan, aron malikayan ang disqualification sa TES program o uban pang programa, siguroa nga dili ka simultaneous nga nakadawat ug pondo gikan sa duha ka lain-laing government subsidies.

en: Wearing shorts is permitted only during intramural sports competitions, such as wearing a jersey to allow for better movement.
Shorts are also allowed if required for specific academic activities, such as P.E. presentations.
Outside of these specific instances, wearing shorts on campus is strictly prohibited.
ceb: Ang pagsul-ob og shorts gitugotan ra panahon sa intramural sports competitions, sama sa pagsul-ob og jersey aron mas sayon ang lihok.
Gitugotan usab kini kung kinahanglan para sa espesipikong academic activities, sama sa mga P.E. presentations.
Gawas ani nga mga sitwasyon, hugot nga bawal ang pagsul-ob og shorts sulod sa campus.
